weights: authorized local weights required; no automatic download
input: same augmented RGB view as UNet; [-1,1] -> [0,1] -> ImageNet mean/std; no additional hidden resize/crop
unet_grid: stride-2 3x3 padding-1 convolutions place level-l centers at 2^l*index
registration: explicit grid_sample at UNet centers, align_corners=false, border extension
augmentation: recompute after exact paired RGB crop/flip; do not assume a pretrained ViT is flip/crop equivariant
injection: zero-initialized trainable 1x1 residual per encoder level
freeze: requires_grad=false, no_grad forward, force eval even when parent train() is called
dropout: same explicit condition_keep gates RGB and all semantic residuals
test_scope: coordinate ramps and mock token-contract encoder; real pretrained feature/weight/runtime compatibility remains to be checked before training
